en.title: Brass Lungs and the Severed Summit
en.premise: In a world that has forgotten the sky, a low-level mechanic discovers an ancient star chart. It is a guide leading to an 'Old Lighthouse' perched atop a summit far beyond the sea of smoke. To save a comrade suffering from lung disease, he boards a forbidden elevator and turns his fury against the ruling class, who claim to dwell in a paradise above the clouds.

zh.title: 黄铜之肺与断绝之巅
zh.premise: 在一个遗忘了天空的世界里，底层的维修工“我”捡到了一张古老的星图。那是通往烟海之巅“古老灯塔”的指路明灯。为了救治患上肺病的同伴，我踏上了禁忌的升降机，向着标榜云端乐园的统治阶层亮出了獠牙。
